displayDescription: One unbroken pull-back and rise in a blue-hour 3D scene: a warm idea sends out spokes, and blocks rise and link into a connected system.
styleRenderer: Three.js 0.186.1 (WebGLRenderer, MeshStandardMaterial, ShaderMaterial sky, TubeGeometry, PCF soft shadows)
motionEngine: GSAP 3.15.0 paused timeline (single linear time driver plus parseEase curves; DOM overlay tweens)
audioDescription: Silent preview with no audio track.
limitations: Blender was not used, at the user's instruction. Three.js real-time rendering stands in for the earlier offline-render path.
Bloom is approximated with additive canvas-gradient halo sprites, not a post-process pass.
Materials are stylized PBR approximations, and lighting uses a hemisphere light, a directional key and a point light, not global illumination.
Edges are revealed by stepping the index draw range in 64 segments per tube.
Overlay text uses system fonts (Georgia, Helvetica/Arial), so glyph metrics may differ slightly between machines.
Not rendered or browser-tested by the agent; host QA is pending.
